notes: This is the Codex credit rate card, not API pricing.
High effort has no separately published flat rate in this card; preserve observed token usage and effort metadata.
Included subscription allowance multipliers differ from purchased credits and cannot be inferred from this card.
Only speed/model combinations explicitly verified here are enabled; older models remain Standard-only in this snapshot, not a claim that other speeds never exist.
Credit purchase prices and discounts depend on plan/agreement; no dollar conversion is assumed.
Local same-token repricing is a counterfactual proxy, not measured avoided Codex spend or weekly quota saved.
